fork.title: The knight fork
fork.goal: Fork the king and the queen with a knight.
fork.rule: A knight check that also attacks the queen wins the queen.
fork.intro: A knight attacks eight squares and cannot be blocked. When it gives check and hits a bigger piece, you win it.

steps.setting: White to move. The black queen and king are a knight's jump apart.

moves.c: The knight checks the king and attacks the queen on d8.
White wins the queen for free.

steps.keyText: Look for a knight check that also attacks the queen.

fork-1.why: The knight checks the king and attacks the queen on d1. You win the queen.

fork-2.why: The knight checks the king and attacks the queen on e8. You win the queen.

fork-3.why: The knight checks the king and attacks the queen on e1. You win the queen.

blundercheck.title: The blunder check
blundercheck.goal: Check every move for loose pieces and checks.
blundercheck.rule: Before you move, ask: what does my opponent attack after this move?
blundercheck.intro: Most of your blunders happen in under five seconds. One question before each move stops them.

steps.keyText: Look at every capture and check your opponent gets.

kpk.title: King and pawn: take the opposition
kpk.goal: Win with king and pawn when your king is in front.
kpk.rule: Put your king in front of the pawn and keep the kings facing each other.
kpk.intro: A king in front of its pawn is worth more than the pawn itself. The defender can only draw by stepping in front.

steps.setting: Black to move. White has the better king.

moves.c: White goes round the other side.
The king keeps in front of the pawn.
White heads for the pawn's path.
The pawn can now advance safely.

steps.keyText: Walk the king round the defender first, then push the pawn.

fork-1.why: The knight checks the king and attacks the queen on d1. You win the queen.

fork-2.why: The knight checks the king and attacks the queen on e8. You win the queen.

fork-3.why: The knight checks the king and attacks the queen on e1. You win the queen.

also.d6e6: The mirror image works just as well.

wrong.d6c5: Black steps in front and the pawn cannot move.

kpk-p.text: Play it out against the computer. You win when the pawn becomes a queen safely.
